The '''CR-1 blaster cannon''' (also called the '''CR-1 blast cannon''') was a shotgun-like heavy [[blast cannon]] developed by [[Golan Arms/Legends|Golan Arms]].

==Description==
The [[Golan Arms/Legends|Golan Arms]] CR-1 [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannon]] fired multiple [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] bursts per shot.<ref name="BF I guide" /> The bolts spread out at reduced power, which gave the cannon its lethal power, but limited its accuracy at long ranges.<ref name="Force Unleashed Campaign Guide" /> The weapon was capable of dealing damage to not only the primary target but also to any adjacent secondary targets as well.<ref name="Force Unleashed Campaign Guide" /> The CR-1 featured a large energy chamber to generate the high amount of power required in heavy multi-burst weapons,<ref name="Databank">{{DB|technology|cr1blastercannon|CR-1 blaster cannon}}</ref> and was fitted with a shoulder [[Stock/Legends|stock]] equipped with a scope.<ref name="BF I" /> The CR-1 was used as an anti-[[Infantry/Legends|infantry]] blaster [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] weapon,<ref name="BF I guide" /> and cost 2,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] with a weight of 6 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]]. The sale of CR-1 blaster cannons was primarily restricted to legitimate military organizations and police forces.<ref name="Force Unleashed Campaign Guide" />

==History==
Golan Arms manufactured the CR-1 under contract from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and its successor state, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Force Unleashed Campaign Guide" /> The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] liberated a cache of the blaster cannons from a Golan Arms supply depot during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="BF I guide" /> Due to the scarcity of independent arms manufacturers during the reign of the Galactic Empire, Rebel procurement [[Officer/Legends|officers]] were often forced to scrounge through captured weapons depots for suitable weaponry. While infiltrating a Golan Arms depot on [[Ac'fren Spur]], Rebel agents found numerous serviceable weapons dating from the Clone Wars ready for use or modification. The modified CR-1 blaster cannons acquired at Ac'fren Spur<ref name="Databank" /> were used extensively by Rebel forces, especially their [[Rebel pilot/Legends|pilots]],<ref name="BF I">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront]]''</ref> being prized for their tremendous close-range firepower, but limited by their short supply and unusual power requirements.<ref name="Databank" />

==Behind the scenes==
The CR-1 first appeared in the [[Star Wars Battlefront (series)|''Star Wars: Battlefront'']] video game series as the Rebel pilot class' primary weapon. In [[2009]], the [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG online game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' introduced the CR-1 model as a heavy weapon. Players could obtain the in-game heavy weapon by collecting battlefield tokens.
